; ModuleID = 'testdata/diagnostics/in.txt'
source_filename = "testdata/diagnostics/in.txt"
target datalayout = "e-p:64:64-i64:64-n32:64-S128"

@escaped = global ptr null

define ptr @summaries(ptr %safe, ptr %heap, ptr %content, ptr %result, ptr %mixed) {
entry:
  %value = load i8, ptr %safe, align 1
  store ptr %heap, ptr @escaped, align 8
  %loaded = load ptr, ptr %content, align 8
  store ptr %loaded, ptr @escaped, align 8
  store ptr %mixed, ptr @escaped, align 8
  ret ptr %result
}

define ptr @content_result(ptr %p) {
entry:
  %loaded = load ptr, ptr %p, align 8
  ret ptr %loaded
}

define ptr @identity(ptr %p) {
entry:
  ret ptr %p
}

define ptr @through_result(ptr %p) {
entry:
  %result = call ptr @identity(ptr %p)
  ret ptr %result
}

define ptr @through_content_result(ptr %p) {
entry:
  %result = call ptr @content_result(ptr %p)
  ret ptr %result
}

define void @discard_result(ptr %p) {
entry:
  %result = call ptr @identity(ptr %p)
  ret void
}

define void @mutate(ptr %p) {
entry:
  store i8 1, ptr %p, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @call_parameter(ptr %fn) {
entry:
  call void %fn()
  ret void
}
